problems: Silhouette reads as a cross or stylised human with outstretched arms as much as a bird: the wings are near-straight horizontal bars with no gull-like sweep, and the body is a thin vertical line with no body mass.

Right wing is asymmetric with the left. Left wingtip 101868 (~129,227) and right wingtip 97886 (~403,232) sit level, but the right wing's rear corner 98337 (~375,353) and trailing edge 98920 (~336,342) drop far below, so the right wing looks like a hanging limb or leg.

Star 99080 (inner feathers, ~323,244) lies on the wing's inner edge, but its label collides with the 'body at the root of the wings' label and the right-wingtip label, so the key parts are hard to read.
Neck label 'neck, where the head meets t' overlaps the head loop, and the head itself is a tiny loop, so the head reads as a knot rather than a head.
Labels for 'trailing edge of the right wing' and 'rear corner of the right wing' overlap each other and run off the right edge of the frame.
Gold key-star lines are drawn across the blue silhouette and make the outline hard to read; the blue outline itself is a real silhouette, not a copy of the gold lines, which is good.
output.advice: Redraw the silhouette so it reads as a gull in flight, with the head up. (1) Head: make a small rounded head centred near crown 99738 (~278,107) and neck 99874 (~270,131), so the head is clearly separate from the neck. (2) Body: taper a teardrop from the neck down to the root of the wings at 99853 (~269,247), then continue down to the tail. Put upper breast 99824 (~272,191) on the chest, widest just below it. (3) Wings: make them mirror-symmetric about the body axis x≈270. Left wingtip 101868 (~129,227) and right wingtip 97886 (~403,232) should share the same height. Give each wing a gull-like sweep: leading edge arcing up from the root to the tip, trailing edge curving back down to the rear tip. Left rear tip 101867 (~125,305) mirrors to a right rear point near (~415,305), not to 98337 (~375,353). (4) Move 98337 and 98920 up to the right wing's rear trailing edge at about y≈280–300, so the right wing matches the left. Move 99080 (inner feathers) onto the inner trailing edge at about (300,260), away from the wing-root label. (5) Tail: taper from the body down to 99742 (~276,470) and split the tip into a forked or string-like tail so it reads as a bird tail. (6) Labels: move 'body at the root of the wings' left of the star and 'inner feathers' below it so they stop overlapping. Keep the neck label clear of the head loop and keep the rear-corner and trailing-edge labels inside the frame. (7) Keep the blue silhouette as the main shape and draw the gold key-star lines thinner or lighter so they don't hide the outline."
